def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits within 8 bits; the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post k != 0 or out == x
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(181, 0) == 181
    ex rotl8(240, 4) == 15
    return (x << k) | (x >> ((8 - k) % 8))
